metadata.description: Collection de plugins Claude Code du groupe Guyeux (FEMTO-ST, Université Marie et Louis Pasteur) : phylogénomique évolutive bactérienne, génétique des populations humaines, rédaction scientifique et outillage transverse.

plugins.name: bio_pathogens
plugins.description: Academic research toolkit for computational genomic studies of bacterial pathogens (MTBC phylogenomics, comparative genomics, published-research surveillance literature).

plugins.name: bio_population_genetics
plugins.description: Academic research toolkit for ancient and modern human population genetics, archaeology, paleoclimate, migration corpora, plus general phylogenetics, statistics and literature-mining tools.

plugins.name: bio_redac
plugins.description: Phase hybride analyse bioinformatique et rédaction d'articles (agrège les skills des autres plugins via symlinks).

plugins.name: redac
plugins.description: Rédaction pure : LaTeX, slides, manuscrits, vérification de références et de figures.

plugins.name: ia
plugins.description: Outils d'intelligence artificielle, machine learning et data science.

plugins.name: multimedia
plugins.description: Outils multimédia : sous-titrage de films muets, audio/vidéo, synthèse vocale, métadonnées de films.

plugins.name: ops
plugins.description: Outils pour les projets PrédictOps, OptimOps, DoctrinOps.

plugins.name: maboss
plugins.description: MaBoSS / CoLoMoTo toolkit: .bnd/.cfg Boolean-model authoring (official refcard grammar), the pyMaBoSS API and Oscar Dufossez's CCT temporal-logic evaluator, and the ecosystem map (WebMaBoSS by Vincent Noel, model repositories, positioning vs INDRA). For cancer signalling modelling and the mabossDemo literature-coherency project.
